name: Leganiel (Spain)
description: Divided by two diagonal lines from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a yellow hoist, a white central band and a blue fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Leganiel (a castle, a cross of Saint James and mountains above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Leganiel; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad white band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
Leganiel arms — castle, cross of Saint James and mountains above waves
